text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. There were also complaints about the limited menu range and the absence of cups for water, which affected the overall service experience. Additionally, some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes. These concerns suggest a need to review and improve the food offerings and related services.

windows.60: Recent visitor reviews indicate several concerns with the food offerings at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, particularly regarding flavor and portion size. Multiple comments mention salads and entrees as bland or awkwardly combined, and there is feedback about limited menu options and the absence of complimentary water cups. Service and wait times were also noted by some visitors, suggesting these areas may need attention. Overall, the average rating is slightly above three, with more than half of the reviews expressing critical views.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported that the menu is limited and some dishes lack flavor or are poorly prepared, with specific complaints about bland or mismatched items. Wait times and service disruptions were also noted, including long lines and kitchen delays that left visitors uncertain about when food service would resume. Additionally, some reviewers felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes and quality. While the library itself received positive remarks, the dining experience needs attention to meet visitor expectations.
